description:
You've just sauntered into a bedroom.

You make out a closed chest drawer here. You see an antique trunk. You bend down to tie your shoe. When you stand up, you notice a king-size bed. You shudder, but continue examining the king-size bed. The king-size bed is usual. However, the king-size bed, like an empty king-size bed, has nothing on it. You think about smashing the king-size bed to bits, throwing the bits into the garbage, etc, until you get bored.

There is a closed wooden door leading east.
inventory: You are carrying nothing.

thought: I should examine the antique trunk to see if there is anything useful inside.
feedback: The antique trunk looks strong, and impossible to crack. It is closed.
